purpose: Reflect on a general tendency, memory, or strong impression.
keywords: Plain clause + ものだ; habitual memory uses Vた + ものだ
When I was a child, I used to play in the river a lot.
formation: Plain clause + ものだ; habitual memory uses Vた + ものだ
restrictions: The meaning depends on tense and context: general truth, recollection, or wonder.
mistake: Do not treat every ものだ as a past habit.
